children: New Delhi, Nov. 15 -- Raj Shamani, Founder of Figuring Out Media, has become the most -subscribed podcaster on YouTube with his flagship show Figuring Out. According to the company, the show recently crossed 22 million subscribers on the platform, surpassing Steven Bartlett's The Diary of a CEO (21.9 million) and The Joe Rogan Experience (21.2 million). It became the most-subscribed podcast globally.

Hailing from Indore, Raj Shamani launched his podcast Figuring Out with Raj Shamani in 2021, focusing on entrepreneurship and personal development. The show went on to compete with some of the successful podcasts from India, such as The Ranveer Show by Ranveer Allahbadia aka BeerBiceps, WTF is with Nikhil Kamath by Zerodha co-founder Nikhil Kamath, The Prakhar Gupta Xperience by Prakhar Gupta and more.

Over the years, the show featured several prominent global figures, entrepreneurs, scientists, leaders, celebrities and public personalities, such as OpenAI CEO Sam Altman, Bill Gates, Vijay Mallya, French President Emmanuel Macron, Deepinder Goyal of Zomato, Falguni Nayar, Ritesh Agarwal of OYO, Aman Gupta, Kunal Shah, Nikhil Kamath, Ankur Warikoo, Frank Walliser, Mel Robbins, Anupam Kher, Gita Gopinath, Barbara Butcher, Aamir Khan, Karan Johar, Ravi Kishan, Former CJI DY Chandrachud and more.

Reflecting on the milestone, Raj Shamani recalled his journey so far. He said in a press note, "When I started Figuring Out in a small room in Indore, I had one obsession: understanding how the world's most extraordinary people think, what they know that the rest of us don't, and what makes them different. I've always believed that where you come from shouldn't determine what you get to learn or who you get to learn from. You shouldn't have to be born into the right family, live in the right city, or have access to the right rooms to learn from the greatest minds in the world."

"Figuring Out was built for ambitious people. People who are curious, hungry to learn, and believe there's more they're capable of becoming. 22 million subscribers is an incredible milestone, but what excites me more is knowing that millions of people across the world share that ambition. Every conversation is an opportunity to understand something we didn't know before, challenge how we think, and expand our sense of what's possible. We're still just getting started. My ambition is to build Figuring Out into a global media institution that brings the world's most extraordinary minds, ideas, and conversations to anyone, anywhere, who wants to build an extraordinary life."

title: Raj Shamani beats Joe Rogan, Steven Bartlett to become YouTube's top podcaster with 22 million subscribers
